summary.headline: Workday requires building integration apps via the Developer Console and App Hub, using tenant-bound OAuth authentication rather than public self-serve app registration.
summary.type_note: Workday integrations and OAuth setups are bound to specific Workday tenants, implementation environments, and company administration rather than a public developer app store.

difficulty_factors.reason: Requires a Workday Developer account and access to the Developer Console and App Hub.
Apps must be promoted through Implementation, Sandbox, and Production release cycles managed by company administrators.
No published timeline; depends on organizational tenant provisioning and review.
Requires access to Workday tenants (Implementation, Sandbox, Production) via enterprise partnership or customer relationship.
Production deployment requires tenant administrators to install and configure the app.

setup_effort.estimate: Multiple days of enterprise integration setup

can_start_today.reason: You can access public developer documentation and llms.txt today, but creating apps requires a Workday developer account and tenant access.

confidence.reason: Official developer site structure and integration app lifecycle documentation were directly probed and verified.

blockers.title: Tenant and Enterprise Bound Access
blockers.detail: Workday does not use generic consumer OAuth app registration; apps are built and promoted across specific Workday tenant environments (Implementation, Sandbox, Production).
blockers.workaround: Obtain access through a Workday customer or partner developer program.

steps.title: Create a Workday Developer Account
steps.action: Sign up for a Workday developer account to access the Developer Console and App Hub.
steps.why_human_only: Requires creating an authenticated developer account on Workday's gated platform.

steps.title: Build Integration App
steps.action: Use Workday Orchestrate for Integrations and the App Hub to create your integration app and save your code.
steps.why_human_only: Requires developer console access and proprietary low-code orchestration builder tools.

steps.title: Promote and Test in Implementation / Sandbox
steps.action: Promote your app from Implementation Release to Sandbox Release to test your integrations against preview tenants.
steps.why_human_only: Requires access to provisioned Workday Sandbox and Implementation tenants.

steps.title: Release to Production
steps.action: Promote your app to Production Release so your Company Administrator can install and configure it on Production tenants.
steps.why_human_only: Requires company administrator permissions and production tenant access.
